guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve the existing source-bound manifest, shard, aggregate, receipt, coverage, and critical-boundary checks.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Final project-test aggregate, critical coverage, receipt, and focused manifest tests passed.

guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Project Ruff and mypy checks passed; one existing manifest/shard ownership path is retained.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Document public Make targets and the local-versus-hosted/adopter execution boundary in all maintained locales.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese quality-gate docs describe bounded shards, coverage path aliases, and hosted/adopter boundaries; alignment checks passed.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Do not claim performance improvement beyond comparable measured evidence.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Same-base serial baseline was 550.85s and the final locked-environment candidate was 343.22s on the same local environment (~37.7% lower wall time); claims are limited to this measurement.

risk.detail: A bounded local shard DAG can reduce wall time but must preserve exact source identity, coverage, shell boundaries, diagnostics, and deterministic receipt validation under resource contention.

observedIssues.detail: Initial isolated candidate runs exposed relative output-path and deleted-worktree source bindings; both were corrected in this Work Item and the final candidate aggregate passed.

The locked coverage reporter also rejected a deleted temporary fixture after JSON generation; aggregate JSON and report now ignore only unavailable ephemeral sources while retaining the 85.10 floor and critical-coverage gate.
The Japanese quality-gate sentence triggered the repository number-spacing rule; it was corrected before the final candidate.

residualRisks.detail: Local speedup is environment-specific and cannot be generalized without comparable evidence across environments.
Full strict quality remains serialized at the Work Item level; concurrent full-repository runs can invalidate timing and extend runtime.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.

userCorrectionsCaptured: User authorized continuous execution through genuine closure of the remaining Work Items.
User identified performance as a practical bottleneck and authorized optimization after the parallel-processing lessons.
User requires evidence-backed completion reporting and does not authorize weakening trust or verification boundaries.

userCorrectionSolidification.correction: Continue until the remaining Work Items are genuinely closed.

checkpointEvidence.reason: The first full candidate exposed that isolated worktrees produced coverage data bound to deleted absolute paths; this amendment adds pyproject coverage relative_files configuration so aggregate coverage remains valid without retaining shard worktrees.

The relative-files experiment exposed a second coverage edge case: temporary fixture modules became ambiguous relative paths. Replace it with coverage path aliases that map only isolated shard scripts sources back to the repository while preserving fixture path identity.

Strict locked quality runs coverage.py 7.15.0, which rejects aggregate JSON when ephemeral fixture modules disappear after their tests. Keep the 85.10 report floor and source-path aliases, but pass --ignore-errors only to aggregate JSON so missing temporary fixture sources do not invalidate otherwise source-bound production coverage.

Align requested operation with the governed runtime helper change in scripts/quality_test_manifest.py so diff ownership treats the implementation as repository governance enforcement rather than a test-only effect.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Each manifest entry has one owner, aggregate coverage and critical coverage pass, and the receipt is current and verified.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused suite and final serialized make project-test.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A shard fails, is missing, or reports a mismatched source identity
scenarioCoverage.expected: Aggregation and receipt validation fail closed while preserving shard diagnostics; no green project-test result is emitted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Manifest failure-path tests and observed candidate diagnostics.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Concurrent shard outputs and coverage data are combined
scenarioCoverage.expected: Shard artifacts remain isolated, coverage is combined exactly once, and no shell boundary is silently skipped or duplicated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Final five-shard candidate and aggregate receipt.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Same-base serial baseline is compared with the candidate
scenarioCoverage.expected: Timing evidence records both runs and limits conclusions to measured wall time on the same environment.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare exact-base serial and final candidate /usr/bin/time evidence.

overclaimPrevention: Do not report a general performance improvement, test completeness, or green quality result unless the corresponding same-base timing, exact manifest ownership, aggregate coverage, receipt, and strict lifecycle evidence is present.
